description: This SoftwareX package tests methods for recognizing overhead power lines in aerial scenes. Its contributors publish MATLAB scripts for five feature-extraction and selection routes, including discrete-cosine-transform regions, local binary patterns and histograms of gradients. The article describes a subsequent WEKA classification step. Users supply infrared or visible-light images; the own README lists a small test set with and without wires. The output is a scene-level power-line classification for each supplied image, with coverage and pixel resolution set by the imagery. It can help prepare an asset-presence layer or aircraft-hazard scenario, but it does not locate a wire precisely along its full route. The public code is free under MIT. MATLAB and WEKA are separate dependencies. A limitation is that the small listed test set does not establish accuracy across lighting, terrain and camera conditions. No related catalogue record was identified. No image, classifier or software was run.
